sites.downstream: Generated recipe object (name, ingredients, steps) is JSON-stringified to stdout; token usage and finish reason are printed as diagnostics
sites.reason: All schema fields are open-ended strings requiring free-form content generation (recipe name, ingredient names/amounts, cooking steps). Jev 1.13 cannot generate text; it returns typed decisions from closed option sets. Structured JSON output does not convert generation into a decision. No closed-set selection or routing is present.

options.benefit: No change; avoids forcing a decision model onto a generation task. Zero integration risk.
options.risk: None. The site is fundamentally generative and cannot be served by a System One model.
